text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Some things can't be put into words.
They can't
be understood when spoken.
But...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The qi flowing through the dirt can tell
me! It's
showing me how Tarumae feels!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(And this passion is Acute's—the
thoughts and
feelings she's carried and
run with for so many
years!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(These are the true faces of the two
battling to be
the best on the dirt track!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Amazing... Truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Normally, you wouldn't be able to tell.
You
wouldn't even be able to see it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea they were running with
such passion
hidden inside.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Yeah. Today was just the tip
of the
iceberg.
choice_data_list: お疲れ様。ナイスチャレンジだったな
お疲れ様。ナイスチャレンジだったね
choice_data_list_en: Good work. That was a nice challenge.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I learned just how incredible dirt
racers are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui has heightened her senses,
making her
more susceptible to her
environment. The passion
she felt today
sinks in deep, moistening her eyes
with
tears.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No words are exchanged. Not of praise,
nor
encouragement. Because this is just
the prelude.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. On the track, we're rivals. It'd be
stranger if
we were buddy-buddy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Rickey? You're not hurt
anywhere,
are you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute! You're such an angel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how intense the race, Wonder
Acute is
as kind-hearted as always.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was overwhelmed by how incredible
those two
were today. Still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I sure did! For one, I think I understand
them a bit
better now.
choice_data_list: 得たものはあったよな
得たものはあったよね
choice_data_list_en: You definitely gained something from it, right?
You definitely gained something from it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't just learn. I left something of
my own,
too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. A memory of my running. Of me.
Something
that will stick with them.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It might be faint, but I'm sure it will have
an effect
in the upcoming Champions
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui isn't only about the external
landform!
It's about the internal
compass, too! Just you wait
and see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rickey is back to her usual, cheerful self,
and just
like that, the trio's first race
together comes to an
end.
